name: commonslens
title: CommonsLens
description: CommonsLens is a free, open-source web application for discovering, exploring, organizing, and reusing Wikimedia Commons media. It combines advanced search, structured-data filtering, geographic exploration, multimedia inspection, licensing assistance, browser-local collections, and verified bulk downloads. A visual, no-code pipeline builder enables researchers to construct and export structured media metadata datasets. CommonsLens requires no account and is independently developed.
keywords: Wikimedia Commons, Wikidata, media discovery, advanced search, structured data, geospatial search, metadata export, dataset creation, visual pipelines, bulk downloads
